faq.a: A digital invitation is a beautiful web page designed specifically for your event. Guests open it by tapping a link or scanning a QR code — no app download needed. It includes all event details, photos, map, countdown, and RSVP.

faq.q: Do my guests need to install anything?
faq.a: No. The invitation opens directly in any web browser. Android, iPhone, old phones — it works on all of them. Just tap the link.
The Simple package is ready in 3 days after you send us your details. Signature is 5 days. Custom timelines we agree together. Rush delivery is available — ask us on Telegram.

faq.q: Can I change details after it goes live?
faq.a: Yes! One of the biggest advantages over printed cards. If your venue changes, the time shifts, or you want to add information — we update the page and all existing links automatically show the new details.

faq.q: Can you do Amharic and Ethiopian calendar dates?
faq.a: Absolutely. We support bilingual (English + Amharic) invitations with the Ethiopian calendar date displayed alongside the Gregorian date.

faq.q: What about guests who don't use smartphones?
faq.a: We give you a print-ready QR code you can put on a physical card. Older relatives still receive a beautiful printed card, and the QR takes them to the full digital invitation. You can also share the link by SMS.
We accept Telebirr, CBE Birr, and bank transfer. Payment details are shared once we confirm your order. No payment is required upfront — we confirm all details first.

faq.q: How long does the link stay live?
faq.a: Simple: 6 months. Signature: 12 months. Custom: 12+ months. Extensions available.
